_comment: Phase 2.5 STABLE: Cooling test with Jeans-stable truncated BE sphere
_phase: 2.5 of 4: Test ISM cooling equilibrium before IMBH interaction
_units: L=1pc, M=1Msun, V=1km/s => T=0.978Myr, rho=6.77e-23 g/cm³, u=1e10 erg/g
_physics: K&I 2000 cooling: T_eq~6K at n=3000cm⁻³, starts at 20K
_stability: TRULY STABLE: xi_s=3.0 gives R/λ_J=0.48, M/M_J=0.45
_expected: Cloud cools from 20K → ~6-10K equilibrium, remains STABLE
_design_notes: CRITICAL: Critical BE (xi_s=6) ALWAYS has R/λ_J≈0.95 → marginal stability
Solution: Use TRUNCATED BE (xi_s=3.0) → R/λ_J=0.48 << 1 → truly stable
Even if T drops to 6K, Jeans length only shrinks to λ_J~0.6pc
With R=0.48pc, still R/λ_J=0.8 < 1 → stable even at equilibrium
name: Phase 2.5 STABLE: Truncated BE + K&I 2000 Cooling
_cooling_physics: Cloud will cool toward equilibrium over ~few Myr
But R/λ_J = 0.48 << 1 → cloud remains Jeans stable!

stability_check.expected_behavior: Cooling to equilibrium; if approaches Jeans limit, thermal balance prevents further cooling

notes: TRUNCATED BE (xi_s=3.0): Unlike critical BE, truly Jeans stable
R/λ_J = 0.48 at T=20K → safe margin from instability
Even at T_eq=6K, R/λ_J ~ 0.87 < 1 → still Jeans stable
Cloud may approach M_J as it cools, but thermal balance stabilizes
Should run smoothly without timestep collapse
